D: A child psychologist tries to help a frightened boy who says he can see ghosts.
P: Serve the mains when Malcolm sits down at the anniversary dinner.
S: Slow-roasted pork shoulder sliced thin with garlicky broccoli rabe and sharp provolone on small soft rolls.
the little red tent in Cole's room
Strawberries dipped in tempered dark chocolate, then half rolled in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red.
the birthday party that goes wrong for Cole
White bread buttered to the edges, pressed into hundreds and thousands, cut into triangles, stacked high.
M: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner
Salmon fillet roasted skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes, with a beurre blanc of shallot, white wine and cold butter whisked in, crushed potatoes and asparagus.
the kitchen where every cupboard opens on its own
Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter until bubbles set, crisp streaky bacon and soft scrambled eggs stirred slowly in butter, all served with maple syrup and orange juice.
W: the room goes cold when they're close
White chocolate melted into warm cream, cooled to room temperature, folded through whipped cream and a whisked egg white, set in glasses for 4 hours, a few raspberries on top.
K: Cole's mum keeping the house warm
Black tea with a slice of lemon and a spoon of honey, served hot in mugs.

s.how: Roast 1kg pork shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and fennel seeds at 160C for 3 hours, rest and slice thin. Fry 2 bunches broccolini with 3 garlic cloves and chilli. Pile the pork, greens and 150g sliced provolone into 12 slider buns and spoon over the pan juices.

s.note: the little red tent in Cole's room
s.how: Dip 500g dry strawberries in 150g melted dark chocolate. Before it sets, roll half of each in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red. Chill on baking paper until set.

m.note: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner
m.how: Roast 4 salmon fillets skin side down at 220C for 8 minutes. Reduce a shallot with 100ml white wine, then whisk in 120g cold butter cube by cube. Crush 800g boiled potatoes with butter. Steam 2 bunches asparagus.

w.note: the room goes cold when they're close
w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and 1 whisked egg white. Spoon into glasses and set 4 hours. Top with a few raspberries.

d.note: Cole's mum keeping the house warm
d.how: Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L just-boiled water for 3 minutes. Pour into 4 mugs, add a slice of lemon and a teaspoon of honey to each and stir.
